_what_this_is: The hard pin for Milestone B. verify_milestone_b_receipt compares a receipt's account_id against this value BYTE-FOR-BYTE - no strip, no case folding, no normalisation - and raises PlatformCredentialMismatchException on any deviation, including a single byte.

_provenance.verified_by: GET /v1/account, using the account's own live key supplied by the owner, on 2026-10-07
_provenance.status: This is an API read by the team, not an owner attestation. It is the strongest form of evidence the milestone asks for: the account naming its own id.

_account_activity_when_read._why: Read from this account's own key at the same time the pin was. This is the fact that keeps Milestone B unmet: pinning an account names it, it does not show the account ever took money. engine/gate.py reads the summary field for the honest label the demo prints, so update it only from a fresh read of this same account - a stale zero here would become a false claim.

_correction_on_the_record: The pin was briefly withdrawn on 2026-10-06 on the strength of the owner's Stripe sandboxes panel, which listed this same id under a row labelled 'Test mode'. That inference was WRONG: in Stripe's sandbox UI the test-mode environment of a live account is listed under the LIVE account's own id, because test mode is a mode of that account rather than a separate account. The separate named sandbox in that panel (acct_1TbxUF18XmnvWsvL) is a distinct account.

Reading GET /v1/account with this account's live key returns exactly this id, with charges and payouts both enabled. The id the owner supplied was correct all along; the withdrawal was the team's error.
_still_not_satisfied: Pinning the account does NOT satisfy Milestone B. A receipt still needs a payment_intent_sample that resolves IN THIS ACCOUNT, livemode true, both capability booleans true, and a timestamp.

This account has never taken a live payment: 0 charges, 0 payment intents, $0 available, $0 pending (read 2026-10-07). So there is no live payment sample to cite, and the milestone cannot be recorded yet.

The $1.00 charge and $0.67 payout the team had been quoting belong to a DIFFERENT account - the platform's managed Stripe connection (404 when this account's key reads that payment intent). They are not evidence for this account.

_owner_decision_2026-10-07.decision: Use Profit Recovery Partners (acct_1TbxU10xRANq8tnU) as the fee account for now.
_owner_decision_2026-10-07.and: Leave the live-billing milestone UNRECORDED until a real payment lands in it. The gate must not be talked into opening by anything else.
_owner_decision_2026-10-07.consequence: Milestone B stays unmet by choice, not by omission. Every client stays STATUS_BETA_TESTER. The first genuine live payment through this account is what satisfies the milestone - not a config edit, not an assertion, and not a test.

_never: Never edit this value to make a receipt pass. A changed pin invalidates every receipt already bound against it and forces a fresh verification event.
